name: Billy Idol

whyMatters.en: Generation X frontman turned solo MTV act. Rebel Yell (1983) paired punk sneer with Steve Stevens guitar hooks and gated drums on 1980s alternative and hard-radio crossover.
whyMatters.zh: Generation X 主唱转独唱 MTV 行动。《Rebel Yell》（1983）把朋克冷笑、Steve Stevens 吉他钩子与门限鼓放上 1980 年代 alternative 与硬电台跨界。

lyricQuotes: In the midnight hour she cried more, more, more
It's a nice day to start again

shortBio.en: Ex-Generation X solo, 1981–. Rebel Yell and White Wedding are the punk-to-MTV hits.
shortBio.zh: 前 Generation X 独唱，1981 年至今。《Rebel Yell》与《White Wedding》是朋克到 MTV 热单。

body.en:
William Broad fronted Generation X (1976–1981) in London punk. Solo career starts with Dancing with Myself (a Generation X song reworked) and Billy Idol (1982). Steve Stevens becomes the guitar signature: Les Paul/Strat hooks, flamenco flourishes on Rebel Yell.

Rebel Yell (1983, Keith Forsey) is the citation LP—gated reverb drums, shout chorus, MTV video rotation. Eyes Without a Face is the ballad/dynamic drop. Treat the act as Billy Idol solo with Stevens as long-term co-writer and guitarist.
body.zh:
William Broad 在伦敦朋克期主唱 Generation X（1976–1981）。独唱从《Dancing with Myself》（Generation X 曲重做）与《Billy Idol》（1982）起步。Steve Stevens 成吉他签名：Les Paul/Strat 钩子，《Rebel Yell》上的弗拉门戈装饰。

《Rebel Yell》（1983，Keith Forsey）是引用 LP——门限混响鼓、喊叫副歌、MTV 轮播。《Eyes Without a Face》是谣曲/动态回落。把行动当作 Billy Idol 独唱，Stevens 为长期共写与吉他手。

title.zh: 朋克冷笑进 MTV 钩子

body.en:
Idol keeps Generation X attitude—short phrases, sneer vocal—then writes for gated-drum radio with Stevens.

Rebel Yell is the peak citation: punk energy, hard-rock guitar writing, video-era chorus. Commercial alternative and punk crossover for video-era radio.
body.zh:
Idol 保留 Generation X 态度——短句、冷笑人声——再与 Stevens 为门限鼓电台写作。

《Rebel Yell》是峰值引用：朋克能量、hard-rock 吉他写法、影像期副歌。面向影像期电台的商业 alternative 与朋克跨界。

alt.en: Billy Idol at Austin City Limits Music Festival, 2015

body.en:
Solo brand centered on Idol voice and Stevens guitar from the early 1980s. Rhythm section rotates; writing credit often Idol/Stevens/Forsey.

Generation X is the punk résumé, not the ongoing band name. Peak commercial unit is the Rebel Yell touring band with Stevens.
body.zh:
独唱品牌从 1980 年代初以 Idol 人声与 Stevens 吉他为中心。节奏组轮换；写作常记 Idol/Stevens/Forsey。

Generation X 是朋克履历，非持续乐队名。商业巅峰单位是带 Stevens 的 Rebel Yell 巡演编制。

title.zh: 80 年代朋克到 alt 电台面孔

body.en:
Later punk and alternative acts cite Idol for punk sneer on MTV without soft-rock wash.

The Killers and stadium alt borrow gated-era hook writing nearby. Debt is attitude plus guitar hook, not DIY ethics alone.
body.zh:
后来朋克与 alternative 行动引 Idol：朋克冷笑可上 MTV，不必软摇滚铺底。

The Killers 与体育场 alt 借用邻近门限期钩子写作。债务在态度加吉他钩子，非仅 DIY 伦理。
